description: Source code for HidlSensorHalWrapper class implementing Android sensors HAL interface, including service connection, polling, sensor management, and death handling.

classes.name: HidlSensorsCallback
classes.description: Callback handler for sensor events and sensor connection/disconnection notifications.

classes.name: SensorsHalDeathReceiver
classes.description: Handles death notifications from the sensor HAL service.

methods.name: statusFromResult
methods.description: Converts sensor result enum to status code.

methods.name: convertToSensorEvent
methods.description: Converts a sensor event from V2_1::Event to sensors_event_t.

methods.name: convertToSensorEvents
methods.description: Converts a vector of V2_1::Event to an array of sensors_event_t, handling dynamic sensor info updates.

methods.name: supportsPolling
methods.description: Checks if the sensor HAL supports polling.

methods.name: supportsMessageQueues
methods.description: Checks if the sensor HAL supports message queues.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to the sensor HAL service with a callback.

methods.name: prepareForReconnect
methods.description: Prepares the wrapper for reconnecting to the HAL service.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls sensor events, handling transport errors and reconnection.

methods.name: pollFmq
methods.description: Polls sensor events from the FMQ (Fast Message Queue).

methods.name: getSensorsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the sensor operation mode.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batching parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data.

methods.name: injectSensorData
methods.description: Injects sensor data into the HAL.

methods.name: registerDirectChannel
methods.description: Registers a direct memory channel for sensor data.

methods.name: unregisterDirectChannel
methods.description: Unregisters a direct memory channel.

methods.name: configureDirectChannel
methods.description: Configures a direct memory channel.

methods.name: writeWakeLockHandled
methods.description: Informs the HAL that wake lock handling is complete.

methods.name: checkReturnAndGetStatus
methods.description: Checks the return status of HAL calls and converts to status code.

methods.name: handleHidlDeath
methods.description: Handles death of the HAL service, possibly triggering a fatal error or reconnect.

methods.name: connectHidlService
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the sensor HAL service, trying different versions.

methods.name: connectHidlServiceV1_0
methods.description: Connects to version 1.0 of the sensor HAL.

methods.name: connectHidlServiceV2_0
methods.description: Connects to version 2.0 of the sensor HAL.

methods.name: connectHidlServiceV2_1
methods.description: Connects to version 2.1 of the sensor HAL.

methods.name: initializeHidlServiceV2_X
methods.description: Initializes the HAL service for versions 2.x, setting up queues and callbacks.
